support: Ask a question or report a problem
indexLead: Every window with help has a **?** button near its top-right corner and answers [[F1]]. These pages are what they open, in your language, and they work with no internet.
indexAsk: Press [[F1]] in any window, or click the **?** button. The page of that window opens in your web browser; the application stays open and nothing in it changes.
In Settings the page opens at the section you are looking at. With a control focused that has its own entry, [[F1]] opens that entry.
